correctness.rationale: PASS. The finite dyadic Haar signed transform has at a leaf x an exact row-kernel partition by the first branching depth. Putting b_0=1 and b_(j+1)=(b_j+sigma_j)/2 gives exact row norm sum_j(1-sigma_j b_j)/2+|b_d|. The Bellman recursion F_0(b)=|b| and F_h(b)=max_sigma[(1-sigma*b)/2+F_(h-1)((b+sigma)/2)] preserves F_h=a_h+c_h|b| with a_h=a_(h-1)+(1+c_(h-1))/2, c_h=(1-c_(h-1))/2. It proves U_d=2d/3+5/9+(4/9)(-1/2)^d for all d>=0, and kernel sign choices attain each maximal row. Independent brute-force path optimization through d=9 gives 1,1,2,5/2,13/4,31/8,73/16,167/32,377/64,839/128; these are checks, not the all-depth proof.
